newsitem.title: UK: Schroders says markets may become uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Schroders says markets may become uncertain.

text.p: Schroders Plc, one of the last bastions of the British merchant banking sector, warned on Friday that conditions for its businesses may become more uncertain with elections imminent here and in the U.S..

"Although the second half has started reasonably well, it will not be easy to match two successive record half years," the group said after reporting a record first half pretax profit of 115.9 million pounds ($181.9 million).

Schroders, which made a pretax return on equity of 26 percent and lifted its half year dividend to 6.0 pence -- the top-end of forecasts -- said the environment for the financial sector in the first half had been generally favourable.
The bank, whose shares have seen some hot money thrown at them as bid speculation refuses to die down, said pretax profits jumped from 85.6 million pounds in the first half of 1995.

Schroders' merchant and investment banking arm saw profits rise to 50.7 million pound from 41.7 million, although revenues from corporate finance did not reach the exceptional levels hit in the second half of 1995, the group said.
